description: List inspections linked to a permit UUID. Future scheduled inspections are excluded by default unless result=SCHEDULED or upcoming opts in. An empty list means no linked inspection is held. Coverage varies by source and place; an empty result does not establish that no record exists. Up to 25 results per call. total_capped marks a lower bound; total_unknown means the total is unknown. Pagination guidance is in _notes.

start.description: Instead of page: 1-based position of the first result to return, e.g. start=24 continues after result 23 (as named in `_notes`)

upcoming.description: Future-dated (still scheduled) inspections: exclude (the default, except with result=SCHEDULED), include, or only (soonest first).

name: get_permit_inspections
title: Permit inspections
